disk.title: Disk space guard
disk.description: Free space on the data directory and the Docker volume. Below the critical floor, deploys, pulls and backups are refused before they can fill the disk.
disk.refusing: A volume is below the critical floor. Deploys, image pulls and backups are refused until space is freed.
disk.thresholds: Warns below {{low}} free, refuses risky operations below {{critical}}. Set APP_DISK_LOW_FREE_MB and APP_DISK_CRITICAL_FREE_MB to change this.
